decision_conditions: Notwithstanding the details set out in the submitted Preliminary Drainage Strategy (81827R1), 26th of March 2024, prior to the commencement of any construction work, details of the Sustainable Drainage Strategy shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and must conform with the Landscaping Strategy. The details shall include:Results of infiltration testing to determine the applicability of full and partial infiltration. If infiltration is not deemed acceptable through infiltration testing an appropriate attenuation feature must be provided in line with the London Plan Drainage Hierarchy Final sizes, storage volumes, invert levels, cross-sections and specifications of all SuDS measures Management Plan for future maintenanceReason : To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk, minimise discharge of surface water outside of the curtilage of the property and ensure that the drainage system will remain functional throughout the lifetime of the development in accordance with Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy, DMD 61, and Policies SI12 & SI13 of the London Plan and the NPPFPlease note that this condition has been discharged under application reference 25/01070/CND on 9 June 2025

The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with 30 April 2024 (the date of the decision notice of planning application reference 23/04105/HOU) Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (Section 73 applications cannot vary the original time limit).

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, Location PlanExisting Block Plan 1237_002 Rev ABlock Plan 1237_003 Rev B1237_100 Rev B1237_101 Rev B1237_102 Rev B1237_010 Rev C1237_011 Rev B1237_013 Rev B1237_012 Rev B1237_104, 1237_1601237_151 Rev J1237_150 Rev C1237_050 Rev J1237_154 Rev A1237_151 Rev C1237_052 Rev J1237_152 Rev C1237_053 Rev E1237-303 Rev C1237-300 Rev C1237-301 Rev C1237-302 Rev AArboricultural Report dated March 2024Sustainable Drainage Assessment dated 26th March 2024Sustainable Drainage ProformaReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Prior to any above ground works, details of the proposed materials including, roof tiles, brickwork, fascia and new timber frame windows shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall be a scale of 1:20 with 1:5 sections (including cills, reveals, heads, window furniture). The proposed materials and windows shall be installed in accordance with the approved details prior to occupation. Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the Southgate Green Conservation Area.Please note that this condition has been discharged under application reference 24/02671/CND on 27 September 2024.

Prior to the commencement of the development hereby approved (including all preparatory work), a scheme for the protection of the trees within the site, in accordance with BS5837:2012, including a Tree Protection Plan (TPP) and an Arboricultural Method Statement (AMS) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Specific issues to be dealt with in the TPP and AMS shall include, but are not limited to the following:a)	Location and installation of services/ utilities/ drainage.b)	Methods of demolition within the root protection area ( RPA as defined in BS5837:2012) of the retained trees c)	Details of construction within the RPA or that may impact on the retained trees d)	Tree protection during construction indicated on a TPP and construction and construction activities clearly identified as prohibited in this area.e)	Boundary treatments within the RPAf)	Methodology and detailed assessment of root pruning g)	Arboricultural supervisionh)	The method of protection for the retained treesThe development thereafter shall be implemented in strict accordance with the approved details.Reason: To ensure the retention of and avoidance of damage to retained trees on and off site in the interest of biodiversity, sustainability, and to ensure that a satisfactory standard of visual amenity is provided and maintained in accordance with Development Management Document Policy DMD80.Please note that this condition has been discharged under application reference 25/01070/CND on 9 June 2025

Prior to above ground works details of soft landscaping works including replacement trees shall be carried in accordance with the approved details and shall have a five year maintenance/watering provision following planting and any trees or shrubs which die, becomes severely damaged or diseased within five years of planting shall be replaced with new planting in accordance with the approved details or approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority within the next planting season.Reason: To ensure that the proposed development does not prejudice the appearance of the locality and to preserve and enhance nature conservation interests.

Notwithstanding the approved drawings, the solar panels shall not protrude more than 150mm from the plane of the roofslope or flat roof to which they are attached and, on a pitched roof, panels should not be installed above the highest part of the roof (excluding the chimney). Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the Southgate Green Conservation Area.
